translations.web: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”
translations.bsb: He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be a house of prayer.’ But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”
translations.kjv: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
